en.heading: Submit a Criminal Injuries Compensation Tribunal appeal
en.body: Use this service to upload and submit a completed appeal form. You'll be asked to upload CICA's review letter and any evidence you wish to provide (you're able to provide evidence later if you don't have it now). You're unable to save your progress and return so make sure you have everything you need before getting started.
en.subbody:
As well as uploading a tribunal form, you will also be asked a handful of simple questions. You'll be able to review and change the answers you give to these questions before you submit them.

Uploading and submitting a tribunal form should not take longer than 20 minutes.
en.accessBody: Use this service to access documents the tribunal has shared with you.
en.uploadBody: Use this service to upload documents you wish to share with the tribunal. This could be additional evidence; information requested by the tribunal or submit a question about your appeal.

cy.heading: Cyflwyno apêl i’r Tribiwnlys Iawndal am Anafiadau Troseddol
cy.body: Defnyddiwch y gwasanaeth hwn i lwytho a chyflwyno ffurflen Tribiwnlys Haen Gyntaf sydd wedi’i llenwiFe ofynnir i chi lwytho unrhyw ddogfennau ategol ar wahân, felly gwnewch yn siŵr bod popeth sydd ei angen arnoch gennych wrth law cyn dechrau.
cy.subbody:
Yn ogystal â llwytho ffurflen y tribiwnlys, fe ofynnir ychydig o gwestiynau syml i chi hefyd. Byddwch yn gallu adolygu a newid yr atebion i’r cwestiynau hyn cyn i chi eu cyflwyno.

Ni ddylai gymryd mwy nag 20 munud i chi lwytho a chyflwyno ffurflen tribiwnlys.
cy.accessBody: Defnyddiwch y gwasanaeth hwn i gael mynediad at ddogfennau y mae'r tribiwnlys wedi eu rhannu gyda chi.
cy.uploadBody: Defnyddiwch y gwasanaeth hwn i uwchlwytho dogfennau yr ydych yn dymuno eu rhannu gyda'r tribiwnlys. Gall hyn fod yn dystiolaeth ychwanegol, gwybodaeth y gofynnwyd amdani gan y tribiwnlys neu gyflwyno cwestiwn am eich apêl.
cy.ogl: Mae’r holl gynnwys ar gael o dan Drwydded Agored y Llywodraeth f3.0, oni nodir fel arall
